title: Know your neighbors.
caption: Know your neighbors. 6 geography questions. Pick A or B before swiping for the map reveal. How many did you get? #geography #quiz #maps
sources: Maps: Natural Earth 1:10 million; cover: CNN 1:50 million

slides.alt: Know your neighbors. 6 A/B geography questions.
Which country is entirely surrounded by South Africa? A: Eswatini. B: Lesotho.
B: Lesotho. Lesotho's only neighbor is South Africa. Regional map with South Africa, Lesotho, Eswatini labeled.
slides.title: Lesotho

slides.alt: Which country has more land neighbors? A: Austria. B: Switzerland.
A: Austria. Austria borders eight countries. Switzerland borders five. Regional map with Austria: 8, Switzerland: 5, Germany, Italy, Hungary labeled.
slides.title: Austria

slides.alt: Which country's only neighbors are China and Russia? A: Mongolia. B: Kazakhstan.
A: Mongolia. Mongolia has just two land neighbors. Regional map with Mongolia, Russia, China labeled.
slides.title: Mongolia

slides.alt: Which country does NOT share a border with Brazil? A: Peru. B: Chile.
B: Chile. Peru touches Brazil. Chile does not. Regional map with Brazil, Peru, Chile, Argentina labeled.
slides.title: Chile

slides.alt: Which country is doubly landlocked? A: Afghanistan. B: Uzbekistan.
B: Uzbekistan. Uzbekistan is landlocked, and so is every country it borders. Regional map with Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Afghanistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan labeled.
slides.title: Uzbekistan

slides.alt: Which landlocked country has a Caspian Sea shore? A: Kazakhstan. B: Kyrgyzstan.
A: Kazakhstan. Kazakhstan borders the Caspian Sea, an inland basin with no natural ocean outlet. Regional map with Kazakhstan, Caspian Sea, Kyrgyzstan, Russia labeled.
slides.title: Kazakhstan
